Done. Here's a summary of what was implemented:

- **`studio/src/utils.js`** — Added `generateUniqueTitle(baseTitle, existingTitles)`: if `baseTitle` isn't in the set, returns it unchanged; otherwise strips any trailing `-N` suffix and increments a counter until a free candidate is found.
- **`studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js`** — Imported `generateUniqueTitle`; in `showClone()`, collects existing titles from `Store.fragments.list.data` and sets `this.titleClone` to the deduplicated default before opening the dialog; updated the clone dialog textfield to bind `value="${this.titleClone}"` instead of the raw `this.fragment.title`.

**Files changed:** 2 files, 19 insertions, 2 deletions.
